# PREFLIGHT CHECKLIST
## 1. Power supply
## 1.1. Battery units
- Check that the S.U.P.E.R.P.A.C.M.A.N. generator unit is anchored to the floor. - Check that the SMES unit is anchored to the floor. - Check that the wall mounted substation unit is in working order. - Check that the engineering bay APC's toggled on. - Check the APC units current Load* (W). - Check that the main rooms APC unit Main Breaker is toggled on. - Check the SMES units current Load* (W).
## 1.2. S.U.P.E.R.P.A.C.M.A.N. generator unit.
- Check that the generator unit is properly anchored. - Check that the generator unit is connected to the cable terminal of your SMES via HV. - Check the fuel remaining of the generator unit. - Set the generator unit output power to 36 kW. - Enable Injection.
## 2. Atmospherics
- Check that the air canister is anchored to the connector port. - Check that the air alarm is on the proper settings - Ensure the air vents are not locked out
## 3. Other checks
- Check that the gyroscope is anchored, powered, and enabled. - Check that the mini gravity generator is anchored, powered, and enabled.
## Sidenotes
* - Canary-class shuttles are equipped with two APC units that can be used to appraise the ship's total power consumption. Unmodified Canarys requires ~36 kW of power to remain operational.
